verdict.rationale: Hands-on reports confirm Meilisearch's own batch indexing handles bulk imports at scale: a 7M-article initial import, a self-hosted ~80M-document deployment after batch indexing was added, and 1M records on a small instance. First-party docs only mention adding documents in general terms, and nothing in the pack documents async task tracking for knowing when indexing completes. missing for 10: documented async task/status API to track indexing completion, first-party docs on bulk/batch import throughput and limits.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can bulk-import millions of documents quickly, with async task tracking to know when indexing completes

citations.quote: One team uses Meilisearch in production with a 7-million-article corpus and says it works really well.
